g.text: ELAPACK · BUYER CHECKLIST
Six fields that specify a cleaning cloth
A cloth is defined by the surface it cleans and the checks it must pass, not by a fabric name.
Surface
State the lens or device surface and any manufacturer
restriction before the cloth is chosen.
Fibre and GSM
Ask for the actual composition, GSM and
tolerance in writing — not just a blend name.
Size and edge
Give open and folded dimensions, then inspect the
proposed edge finish on the sample.
Artwork
Confirm which branding methods the fabric
approve a decorated sample.
Quantity and terms
MOQ 200 pieces per product or component; custom sample
USD 30 plus USD 25 shipping, made in 3–5 days.
Acceptance
Agree the care procedure, the cycle count and
cleaning checks you will run on the finished cloth.
Illustrative buyer guidance · confirm material, cleaning performance and sample scope on the actual project
